> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR

> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **18** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c9636f1e50e48a2fee5205f0a9978c2a63f2dc07` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `008b892a8c91953e8b94ff160d020f32d3e87254` — the merge of head `bdfd50d5da015bd6877318bf4c8169f5b14ab996` into base `c9636f1e50e48a2fee5205f0a9978c2a63f2dc07`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 008b892a8c91953e8b94ff160d020f32d3e87254 && git checkout 008b892a8c91953e8b94ff160d020f32d3e87254
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c9636f1e50e48a2fee5205f0a9978c2a63f2dc07 bdfd50d5da015bd6877318bf4c8169f5b14ab996 && git checkout -B drift-repro c9636f1e50e48a2fee5205f0a9978c2a63f2dc07 && git merge --no-ff bdfd50d5da015bd6877318bf4c8169f5b14ab996

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c9636f1e50e48a2fee5205f0a9978c2a63f2dc07
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs c9636f1e50e48a2fee5205f0a9978c2a63f2dc07` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · `domain:server#4` · head `bdfd50d5da015bd6877318bf4c8169f5b14ab996` · 2026-11-03T03:02Z · seat review of record at `TIER_DEFAULT` for the whole PR. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` stand as the seat's route ruling of 01:13Z allowed: the moved readings are ADR-0146 D8 alignment and are listed per type in the changeset. No contract review is owed. Not governed: `check-governed-merges --pr 29707` 0 of 9 paths, +476/−32.

1. **Shape:** draft, base `main`, `Fixes #29613`. 9 files: `declinesStoredRow` (`protocol-lock-state.ts`) admits a page, app, dataset, doc or book row that is the shipping package's declared `.custom` override (`isServedOverrideRowOf` against `packagedArtifactOwner`); the five types join `BORROWED_ENVELOPE_DECLINED_TYPES` beside the new closed `SEALED_ROW_SERVED_OVERRIDE_TYPES` (`protocol-package-bindings.ts`, both lists pinned); `GET /me/apps` reads the protocol's served list when the protocol service is present (`current-user-endpoints.ts`); three comment-only docblock corrections in `protocol.ts`; tests; one `patch` changeset (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`). Inside the claim surface (6592687187).
2. **Premise measured:** before and after per type, without and with a metadata service, and after a restart (PR body table). Ablation reds: 10 objectql, 6 unit, 2 `/me/apps`.
3. **`/me/apps` parity:** it calls `getMetaItems({ type: 'app' })`, the same call shape `GET /meta/app` makes (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts:536`), and that read applies nav contributions (`protocol.ts:4804`), so the endpoint keeps what `registry.getAllApps()` gave it. A failed protocol read warns once and falls back to the registry; pinned.
4. **Serial with #29649:** #29649 landed first (PR #29687, `33ee9aa1`). On the merged head its showcase-boot export pin, the per-type export pin and the customization pins pass 64/64, and the base export stays byte-identical for all eight types. The dev widened that pin's `pairServed` to all eight types (`f40dd0e68`, test-only; ablation 5 red). The seat accepts the edit: it pins what this PR delivers.
5. **Gates on this head:** check-runs pinned to `bdfd50d5`: 52 runs, 37 success, 15 skipped, none failed (`Lint & Repo Gates` success, which runs `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`). Dev local: `dispatch-gates --ran` 65 families accounted for, 64 run, 1 NOT MEASURED (`dual-build-cjs-loads`, prerequisite: every dist; covered by CI above); `pnpm lint` 0; typecheck 0 for metadata-protocol, objectql and plugin-hono-server.
6. **Landing:** not governed, under 3000 lines, no contract review owed ⇒ the seat lands it (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`). At MERGED: landing record on #29613 (closed by `Fixes`), `pm:dispatched` removed; then #25467's next cut may start.
